name: OmniEarth-Bench_MCQ_VLM
description: OmniEarth-Bench_MCQ_VLM evaluates vision-language models on multiple-choice questions grounded in Earth observation imagery and related metadata. It measures visual understanding, domain-specific knowledge (remote sensing/geoscience), and the ability to select correct answers among fixed options. The benchmark emphasizes multimodal reasoning over satellite or aerial images combined with text prompts.
reputation: A niche, recently published HuggingFace dataset aimed at evaluating VLMs on remote sensing tasks; modest community adoption so far.
